00047 template<class ObjectType>
00048 class ObjectArrayInternal : public SmartPointer
00049 {
00050 public: 
00051     ObjectArrayInternal(const int size, const bool isNullTerminated)
00052     :   size_(size <= 0 ? 0 : size), 
00053         array(size_ == 0 ? 0 : new ObjectType[size_]),
00054         arrayIsNullTerminated(isNullTerminated)
00055     {
00056     }
00057     
00058     ~ObjectArrayInternal()
00059     {
00060         delete [] array;
00061     }
00062     
00063     inline int size() const throw() { return size_; }
00064     inline int length() const throw() 
00065     { 
00066         if(size_ == 0) 
00067             return 0;
00068         else
00069             return arrayIsNullTerminated ? size_ - 1 : size_; 
00070     }
00071     
00072     inline ObjectType* getArray() throw() { return array; }
00073     inline const ObjectType* getArray() const throw() { return array; }
00074     inline bool isNullTerminated() const throw() { return arrayIsNullTerminated; }
00075     inline void setNullTerminated(const bool state) throw() { arrayIsNullTerminated = state; } 
00076     
00077     inline void add(ObjectType const& item) throw()
00078     {
00079         const int newSize = size_ + 1;
00080         ObjectType *newArray = new ObjectType[newSize];
00081         
00082         if(arrayIsNullTerminated)
00083         {
00084             const int length = size_ - 1;
00085             
00086             newArray[size_] = array[length];
00087             newArray[length] = item;
00088             
00089             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00090             {
00091                 newArray[i] = array[i];
00092             }
00093         }
00094         else
00095         {
00096             const int length = size_;
00097             newArray[size_] = item;
00098             
00099             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00100             {
00101                 newArray[i] = array[i];
00102             }
00103         }
00104         
00105         delete [] array;
00106         
00107         size_ = newSize;
00108         array = newArray;
00109     }
00110     
00111 private:
00112     int size_;
00113     ObjectType *array;
00114     bool arrayIsNullTerminated;
00115 
00116     
00117     ObjectArrayInternal();
00118     ObjectArrayInternal (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00119     const ObjectArrayInternal& operator= (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00120 };

00260

00375     ObjectArray<ObjectType> at (ObjectArray<int> const& indices) const throw()
00376     {

00380         const int length = indices.length();

00388         for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00389         {

00392         }
00393

00692     ObjectArray<ObjectType> range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00693     {
00694         const int size = this->size();
00695         if(size == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00696         
00697         const int startIndexChecked = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex;
00698         const int endIndexChecked = endIndex > size ? size : endIndex;
00699 
00700         if(startIndexChecked >= endIndexChecked) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00701         
00702         const ObjectType *sourceArray = this->getArray();
00703         if(sourceArray == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00704         
00705         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00706         
00707         const int diff = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00708         const int newSize = needsNull && (endIndexChecked < size) ? diff + 1 : diff;
00709                 
00710         ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(newSize, needsNull);
00711         ObjectType *resultArray = result.getArray();
00712         
00713         int resultIndex = 0;
00714         for(int sourceIndex = startIndexChecked; sourceIndex < endIndexChecked; sourceIndex++)
00715         {
00716             resultArray[resultIndex++] = sourceArray[sourceIndex];
00717         }       
00718         
00719         if(needsNull)
00720             resultArray[resultIndex] = this->getNull();
00721         
00722         return result;
00723     }

00726     {
00727         const int size = this->size();
00728         const int findLength = find.length();
00729         int startIndex = 0;
00730         int findIndex;
00731         
00732         ObjectArray<ObjectType> result;
00733         
00734         while((findIndex = this->indexOf(find, startIndex)) >= 0)
00735         {
00736             result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
00737             result <<= substitute;
00738             startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
00739         }
00740         
00741         result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
00742         
00743         return result;
00744     }

00751         
00752         if(array != 0)
00753         {
00754             const int length = this->length();
00755             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00756             {
00757                 if(array[i] != item)
00758                     result <<= array[i];
00759             }
00760         }
00761         
00762         return result;

00770

00774             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00775             {

00784     
00785     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > group(const int groupSize) const throw()
00786     {
00787         const int length = this->length();
00788         if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00789         
00790         const int groupSizeChecked = groupSize < 1 ? 1 : groupSize;
00791         const int groupSizeMinus1 = groupSizeChecked-1;
00792         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00793         
00794         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
00795         ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
00796         
00797         const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
00798         
00799         for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00800         {
00801             element <<= thisArray[i];
00802             if((i % groupSizeChecked) == groupSizeMinus1)
00803             {
00804                 if(needsNull) 
00805                 {
00806                     element <<= this->getNull();
00807                     element.setNullTerminated(true);
00808                 }
00809                 
00810                 result <<= element;
00811                 element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00812             }
00813         }
00814         
00815         if(element.length() != 0)
00816         {
00817             if(needsNull) 
00818             {
00819                 element <<= this->getNull();
00820                 element.setNullTerminated(true);
00821             }
00822             
00823             result <<= element;
00824         }
00825         
00826         return result;
00827     }
00828     
00829     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > split(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimiters) const throw()
00830     {
00831         const int length = this->length();
00832         if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00833         
00834         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00835         
00836         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
00837         ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
00838         
00839         const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
00840         if(thisArray != 0)
00841         {
00842             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00843             {
00844                 const ObjectType item = thisArray[i];
00845                 
00846                 if(delimiters.contains(item))
00847                 {
00848                     if(element.length() > 0)
00849                     {
00850                         if(needsNull) 
00851                         {
00852                             element <<= this->getNull();
00853                             element.setNullTerminated(true);
00854                         }
00855                         
00856                         result <<= element;
00857                         element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>();    
00858                     }
00859                 }
00860                 else
00861                 {
00862                     element <<= item;
00863                 }
00864             }
00865             
00866             if(element.length() != 0)
00867             {
00868                 if(needsNull) 
00869                 {
00870                     element <<= this->getNull();
00871                     element.setNullTerminated(true);
00872                 }
00873                 
00874                 result <<= element;
00875             }
00876         }
00877         
00878         return result;      
00879     }
00880     
00881     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > splitSequence(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimitingSequence) const throw()
00882     {
00883         const int size = this->size();
00884         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
00885         
00886         if(size != 0)
00887         {
00888             const int findLength = delimitingSequence.length();
00889             int startIndex = 0;
00890             int findIndex;
00891             
00892             while((findIndex = this->indexOf(delimitingSequence, startIndex)) >= 0)
00893             {
00894                 result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
00895                 startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
00896             }
00897             
00898             result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
00899         }
00900         
00901         return result;      
00902     }

00914 #define NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon                                                              \
00915             const unsigned int leftSize = this->size();                                                     \
00916             if(leftSize == 0) return rightOperand;                                                          \
00917             const unsigned int rightSize = rightOperand.size();                                             \
00918             if(rightSize == 0) return *this;                                                                \
00919             const bool eitherNullTerminated = this->isNullTerminated() || rightOperand.isNullTerminated();  \
00920             const unsigned int leftLength = this->length();                                                 \
00921             const unsigned int rightLength = rightOperand.length();                                         \
00922             const int newLength = leftLength > rightLength ? leftLength : rightLength;                      \
00923             const int newSize = leftSize > rightSize ? leftSize : rightSize;                                \
00924             const NumericalType *leftArray = this->getArray();                                      \
00925             const NumericalType *rightArray = rightOperand.getArray()
00926 
00927 
00928 #define NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBody(OPERATOR)                                                          \
00929             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
00930             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
00931             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
00932             if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                            \
00933                                                                                                             \
00934             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
00935                 resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];            \
00936             }                                                                                               \
00937             return result
00938 
00939 #define NumericalArrayBinaryComparisonOperatorBody(OPERATOR)                                                \
00940             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
00941             NumericalArray<bool> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), false);                         \
00942             bool *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                          \
00943                                                                                                             \
00944             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
00945                 resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];            \
00946             }                                                                                               \
00947             return result
00948 
00949 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)                                                          \
00950             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
00951             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
00952             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
00953             if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                            \
00954                                                                                                             \
00955             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
00956                 resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)(leftArray[i % leftLength]),                              \
00957                                           (double)(rightArray[i % rightLength]));                           \
00958             }                                                                                               \
00959             return result
00960 
00961 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)                                                                    \
00962             NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION (NumericalArray<NumericalType> const& rightOperand) const throw()        \
00963             {                                                                                                               \
00964                 NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);                                                           \
00965             }
00966 
00967 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)                                                           \
00968             const int newSize = this->size();                                                               \
00969             const int newLength = this->length();                                                           \
00970             if(newSize == 0) return *this;                                                                  \
00971             const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();                                                \
00972             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), needsNull);            \
00973             const NumericalType *thisArray = this->getArray();                                      \
00974             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
00975                                                                                                             \
00976             for(int i = 0; i < newSize; i++)                                                                \
00977                 resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)thisArray[i]);                                            \
00978                                                                                                             \
00979             if(needsNull) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                                       \
00980             return result
00981 
00982 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)                                                     \
00983             NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION () const throw()                                         \
00984             {                                                                                               \
00985                 NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);                                            \
00986             }

01120     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> line(const int size, const NumericalType start, const NumericalType end) throw()
01121     {
01122         const int numValues = size < 2 ? 2 : size;
01123         
01124         NumericalArray<NumericalType> newArray = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::withSize(numValues);
01125         
01126         double inc = double(end - start) / (numValues - 1);
01127         double currentValue = start;
01128         NumericalType *outputValues = newArray.getArray();
01129         
01130         for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01131         {
01132             roundCopy(currentValue, outputValues[i]);
01133             currentValue += inc;
01134         }
01135         
01136         return newArray;
01137     }

02079     bool contains(ArrayType const& item) const throw()
02080     {
02081         const int numRows = this->length();
02082         for(int i = 0; i < numRows; i++)
02083         {
02084             if(this->atUnchecked(i).ObjectArray<ArrayType>::contains(item))
02085                 return true;
02086         }
02087         
02088         return false;
02089     }
02090     
02095     void indexOf(ArrayType const& item, int& row, int& column) const throw()
02096     {
02097         const int numRows = this->length();
02098         for(int i = row < 0 ? 0 : row; i < numRows; i++)
02099         {
02100             int c = this->atUnchecked(i).ObjectArray<ArrayType>::indexOf(item, column);
02101             if(c >= 0)
02102             {
02103                 row = i;
02104                 column = c;
02105                 return;
02106             }
02107         }
02108         
02109         row = -1;
02110         column = -1;
02111     }
02112     
02113     bool isMatrix() const throw()
02114     {
02115         const int numRows = this->length();
02116         if(numRows < 2) return false;
02117         
02118         int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02119         if(numColumns < 2) return false;
02120         
02121         int prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02122         for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02123         {
02124             numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02125             if(numColumns != prevNumColumns)
02126                 return false;
02127             
02128             prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02129         }
02130         
02131         return true;
02132     }
02133     
02134     int numRows() const throw()
02135     {
02136         return this->size();
02137     }
02138     
02139     int numColumns() const throw()
02140     {
02141         const int numRows = this->length();
02142         if(numRows < 1) return 0;
02143         
02144         int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02145         
02146         int maxNumColumns = numColumns;
02147         for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02148         {
02149             numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02150             if(numColumns > maxNumColumns)
02151                 maxNumColumns = numColumns;
02152         }
02153         
02154         return maxNumColumns;
02155     }
02156 
02157     RowType flatten() const throw()
02158     {
02159         RowType result;
02160         const int numRows = this->length();
02161         for(int i = 0; i < numRows; i++)
02162         {
02163             const RowType& item = this->atUnchecked(i);
02164             result <<= item;
02165         }           
02166         
02167         return result;
02168     }

02447             for(int row = 0; row < this->size(); row++)
02448             {

02450                 
02451                 for(int column = 0; column < rowArray.size(); column++)
02452                 {
02453                     if(prefix) std::cout << prefix;
02454                     
02455                     std::cout << "[" << row << "][" << column << "] = " << rowArray[column] << std::endl;
02456                 }       
02457             }
02458         }
02459     }
